OUT="${1:-./collect-report.txt}"
: > "$OUT"

# ---------- 脱敏函数（内嵌规则，不使用外部依赖） ----------
# 脱敏规则（生成时内嵌，版本随脚本固定）
dsh_desensitize() {
  sed -E \
    -e 's#([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}#<IP>#g' \
    -e 's#([0-9a-fA-F]{2}:){5}[0-9a-fA-F]{2}#<MAC>#g' \
    -e 's#[0-9]{6,}[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{3,}#<SERIAL>#g' \
    -e 's#1[3-9][0-9]{9}#<PHONE>#g' \
    -e 's#/(home|Users)/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+#/***/<USER>#g' \
    -e 's#(sk|ghp|AKIA)[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}#<KEY>#g' \
    -e 's#[a-z0-9-]+\.(corp|internal|local)(\.[a-z]{2,})?#<DOMAIN>#g'
}

TOTAL=$(grep -c '^emit ' "$0" 2>/dev/null || echo '?')
N=0
T0=$(date +%s)
echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] 开始采集：共 ${TOTAL} 个探针 → ${OUT}" >&2
echo "        正常总耗时约 1–3 分钟；探针均有 timeout 上限，慢段会单独提示。" >&2
echo "        进度行写在终端（stderr），不会进报告文件。" >&2

emit() {
  # $1=section  $2=command
  local sec="$1"; shift
  local cmd="$*"
  local t0=$(date +%s)
  N=$((N+1))
  printf '[%s] (%s/%s) 采集中 %s ...\n' "$(date +%H:%M:%S)" "$N" "$TOTAL" "$sec" >&2
  printf '        cmd: %s\n' "$cmd" >&2
  {
    # 2026-09-23 实测缺陷修复：原先段头与 `--- cmd:` 行**未过脱敏管道**，
    # 探针命令里的默认端点/主机名会原样落盘（被插件二次校验当场拒绝：ERR_DESENSITIZE_MISS）。
    # 现全部经 dsh_desensitize，确保"报告在采集端即已脱敏"这条硬约束无绕过路径。
    echo "=== ${sec} ===" | dsh_desensitize
    bash -c "$cmd" 2>&1 | dsh_desensitize
    echo "=== end:${sec} ===" | dsh_desensitize
  } >> "$OUT"
  local t1=$(date +%s); local dt=$((t1-t0))
  printf '[%s] (%s/%s) 完成 %s（%ss）\n' "$(date +%H:%M:%S)" "$N" "$TOTAL" "$sec" "$dt" >&2
  if [ "$dt" -ge 60 ]; then
    printf '        提示：该段较慢（%ss）。多为 timeout 上限或温度时间序列，可继续等待；\n        若想更快：THERMAL_SAMPLES=2 THERMAL_INTERVAL=5 重跑，或按 README 收紧该探针。\n' "$dt" >&2
  fi
}

# ---------- 探针 ----------
emit "logits-probe" 'EP="${VLLM_BASE:-http://127.0.0.1:8000}"; M="${MODEL_NAME:-}"; [ -z "$M" ] && M=$(timeout 10 curl -s --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 30 "$EP/v1/models" | grep -o '\''"id":"[^"]*"'\'' | head -1 | cut -d'\''"'\'' -f4); echo "DSH-SIGNAL logits.model=$M"; TS=$(date +%s); A="probeA-$TS"; B="probeB-$TS"; one(){ timeout 180 curl -s --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 150 "$EP/v1/chat/completions" -H '\''Content-Type: application/json'\'' -d "{\"model\":\"$M\",\"messages\":[{\"role\":\"user\",\"content\":\"用一句话说明什么是张量并行。\"}],\"temperature\":0,\"seed\":7,\"max_tokens\":1,\"logprobs\":true,\"top_logprobs\":5$1}" 2>&1; }; t0=$(date +%s); R1=$(one ",\"cache_salt\":\"$A\""); t1=$(date +%s); R2=$(one ",\"cache_salt\":\"$A\""); t2=$(date +%s); R3=$(one ",\"cache_salt\":\"$B\""); t3=$(date +%s); echo "DSH-SIGNAL logits.salt_supported=$(printf '\''%s'\'' "$R1" | grep -c cache_salt)"; rd(){ printf '\''%s'\'' "$1" | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);c=d['\''choices'\''][0];lp=c.get('\''logprobs'\'') or {};cs=(lp.get('\''content'\'') or [{}])[0];t5=cs.get('\''top_logprobs'\'') or [];print('\''tok=%r lp=%s top5=%s ptok=%s'\'' % (cs.get('\''token'\''), cs.get('\''logprob'\''), '\'','\''.join('\''%s:%s'\''%(x.get('\''token'\''),x.get('\''logprob'\'')) for x in t5[:5]), (d.get('\''usage'\'') or {}).get('\''prompt_tokens'\'')))" 2>/dev/null || echo '\''<无法解析：'\''$(printf '\''%s'\'' "$1" | head -c 160)'\''>'\''; }; echo "--- [路径1 完整重算#1 salt=$A] $(rd "$R1") 耗时$((t1-t0))s"; echo "--- [路径2 同salt命中]      $(rd "$R2") 耗时$((t2-t1))s"; echo "--- [路径3 换salt完整重算#2] $(rd "$R3") 耗时$((t3-t2))s"; C1=$(printf '\''%s'\'' "$R1" | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print((d['\''choices'\''][0].get('\''logprobs'\'') or {}).get('\''content'\'',[{}])[0].get('\''logprob'\''))" 2>/dev/null); C3=$(printf '\''%s'\'' "$R3" | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print((d['\''choices'\''][0].get('\''logprobs'\'') or {}).get('\''content'\'',[{}])[0].get('\''logprob'\''))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$C1" ] || [ -z "$C3" ]; then echo "DSH-SIGNAL logits.prefill_repeat_consistent=n/a (端点未返回可解析的 logprobs：**不下结论**，不把失败当成漂移)"; elif [ "$C1" = "$C3" ]; then echo "DSH-SIGNAL logits.prefill_repeat_consistent=true（两次完整重算首 token logprob 相同 → 采样前无漂移）"; else echo "DSH-SIGNAL logits.prefill_repeat_consistent=false（两次完整重算首 token logprob 不同 → **采样前已漂移**：这是比文本乱码强得多的判据，直接指向长 prefill 计算/地址路径）"; fi'

T1=$(date +%s)
echo "[$(date +%H:%M:%S)] 完成：报告写入 $OUT（本机已脱敏，明文不落盘）；总耗时 $((T1-T0)) 秒。" >&2
